# /schedule route fixtures (R17.2)

Recorded from a hermetic scratch gateway (abstractgateway origin/main 8da325f, runtime cec1eb8, core 3e247a95,
agent 60d5d2b; user `alice`), 2026-10-08:

- `input_schema_basic_agent.json` — `GET /api/gateway/bundles/basic-agent/flows/81795ea9/input_schema?bundle_version=0.0.5`
  (the gateway default agent: served `tools` default, no required pins).
- `input_schema_react_agent.json` — `GET …/bundles/react-agent/flows/react/input_schema?bundle_version=0.1.0`
  (a native loop: `prompt` required).
- `me_email_not_connected.json` — `GET /api/gateway/me/email` for an account with no mailbox (`effective_enabled: false`).

Stubbed from the recorded shape (a real mailbox is not needed; the gateway's own `public_status` rules):

- `me_email_connected.json` — the same answer with a connected, enabled mailbox (`effective_enabled: true`).
- `me_email_admin_disabled.json` — the administrator turned mailboxes off (`admin_enabled: false`, `admin_disabled`
  {cause, fix} with the gateway's ADMIN_DISABLED_CAUSE / _FIX sentences).

`web_schedule_bodies.json` is generated by `tui/scripts/web_schedule_body.ts` from the Code web's and the kit's own
functions (see that script); `cargo test schedule_body_equals_the_web` compares the terminal's POST body with it.

Round 16 merge (R16-M1, 2026-10-09): regenerated with the same script and the same cases against the round-16
kit (abstractuic `caad82a`, ui-kit `dist/` built from `origin/round16/2026-10-08` + its merges) — the only
change is the trigger: `schedule@2` with `kind: "every"` (the kit's `scheduleConfigFrom`). The email case is
unchanged (`email.received@1`).
